newsitem.title: USA: Meditrust completes $453 mln in investments.
newsitem.headline: Meditrust completes $453 mln in investments.

text.p: Meditrust said on Tuesday it has completed $453 million of real estate investments for the nine months ended September 30.
The company said $152 million of this was completed in third quarter ended September 30, and that it had planned on $400 million in new investments for the nine months.

Meditrust said it received $23 million in sale/leaseback financing for six assisted living facilities in California, Florida, Idaho and Texas. It said it also received $70 million permanent mortgage financing for 17 long-term care facilities and one assisted living facility.

Meditrust also provided funding of $16 million to develop one long-term care facility in Nevada and seven assisted living facilities, and $43 million for on-going construction of facilities already in the portfolio.
As of September 30, the company said it had existing financing commitments of about $179 million for ongoing real estate projects.
